name: Michel-Marie Maudet
bio: Michel-Marie Maudet is co-founder and managing director (directeur général) of LINAGORA, the French open-source software company founded in 2000. Maudet launched the OpenLLM France community in 2023, which led to Lucie-7B, an open French-focused language model, and the associated Lucie training dataset.
known_for: Co-founder and managing director of LINAGORA
Founder of the OpenLLM France community
